remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom condo in a sought-after downtown Stamford building offering modern comfort and unbeatable convenience. This bright, move-in ready home features new flooring throughout, updated bathrooms, and a brand-new AC system. The open-concept layout is highlighted by soaring 16+ foot ceilings, creating a spacious and airy atmosphere filled with natural light.  A versatile loft provides the perfect space for a home office, guest area, or additional living space, while the other room offers endless possibilities for storage, a den, or flex use. Enjoy a private patio ideal for relaxing or entertaining.  Residents enjoy premium building amenities including an elevator, fitness center, on-site concierge, private courtyard with grills, and covered garage parking with direct elevator access. Pet-friendly community.  Located just steps from Stamford's best restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and public transportation, this home offers the perfect blend of style, functionality, and downtown living.
